author: Inside Edition
description: Athletes who compete in grueling Ironman competitions have to be able to handle just about anything, but an extreme sports coach recently encountered something beyond the scope of  triathlons. Jonathan Bruney was swimming in South Carolina's Savannah River when he was attacked by an alligator. The only way for him to save his life was to aim his thumb at the gator's eye. Thankfully, Bruney lived to tell the tale of his frightening brush with a deadly predator.
title: Swimmer Survives Gator Attack By 'Aiming For The Eye'

author: Inside Edition
description: The jury is out in the emotionally charged Massachusetts murder trial of Lindsay Clancy. The mother says she strangled her three children while she was in the throes of postpartum psychosis in 2023. There was tension in court today, as her defense attorney insisted that she was, in his words, "a darn good mother,” while the prosecution argued she was clear minded when she made the calculated decision to kill her three children. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano is at the courthouse.
title: Lindsay Clancy's Attorney Says She Was 'Darn Good Mother'

author: Inside Edition
description: Dolly Parton's millions of fans are mourning her passing with gratitude for what she gave the world. Dolly always seemed upbeat and positive in public, but we're learning her happiness may have been overshadowed by a hidden heartbreak. The legendary singer has been called a force of nature, and by extraordinary coincidence, Tropical Storm Dolly is forming in the eastern Atlantic. Dolly Parton died in Nashville early this week at age 80. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian reports.
title: What Was Dolly Parton's Hidden Heartbreak?

author: Inside Edition
description: "Never again!" That's what Chip Brewer, CEO of the Callaway golf club brand, is saying after a controversial ad backfired big time. The spot shows a female golfer being shoved to the ground as she reaches for a club. The scene has teed off a lot of golfers and golf fans. Brewer took responsibility for the ad and apologized for it. Now, the company says it is trying to get back in the golf community's good graces. Inside Edition's Alison Hall reports.
title: Callaway CEO Apologizes For Shocking Golf Club Ad

author: Inside Edition
description: Three half-finished Los Angeles skyscrapers became known as the "Graffiti Towers," after becoming a target for high-altitude vandalism. Some of the graffiti is even considered artistic, and there are plans to produce a coffee table book showcasing some of it. Now, the buildings' new owners want the graffiti gone in time for the 2028 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles. Inside Edition's Jim Moret climbed to the penthouse to check on a massive clean-up operation.
title: L.A.'s 'Graffiti Towers' Are Getting Scrubbed

author: Inside Edition
description: The voice behind an iconic character has died. Peter Cullen had been a voice of Optimus Prime for many Transformers franchises since the 1980s. Born in Montreal, Canada according to CBC, Cullen got his start in radio in the 1960s, transitioning to television and then film. While he voiced other well-known characters, he is best known for the deep, gravelly, intimidating voice of Optimus Prime. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Peter Cullen, Voice Of Optimus Prime, Dies At 85

author: Inside Edition
description: Yayoi Kusama has died. The internationally recognized avant garde artist passed away from an unspecified cause on August 14th at a hospital in Tokyo according to her studio's website, which says she was still painting until her final days. Kusama was born in Matsumoto City in 1929 and from a very young age claimed to experience hallucinations. The visions served as the inspiration for her colorful, polka-dot-themed works. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Yayoi Kusama, Avant Garde Japanese Artist, Dies At 97
